title: Re-freeze Pilot 1 as T1-only; bridge the calibration report to the new dataset hash
reason: The T2 trigger (code round 4, admitted) needs the checkpoint-3 round signals to fire. A store-era reconstruction leaves reopenRate, severityDrift and retired unmeasured and an unmeasured signal never fires, so no T2 point can be reproduced. Measured by the free dry-run on 2026-11-23 on a pinned main: 0 of 14 T2 points in the rehearsal and pilot sets could run, leaving 1 of 5 rehearsal points and 6 of 16 pilot points runnable, below the pre-registered floor of 24 valid pairs.

excludedTriggers.T2: the checkpoint-3 round signals cannot be reproduced from store-era data

alsoChanged: The freeze now checks, with cheap git lookups and no checkout, that a point's plan file exists in the tree its round audits and that a code point has a diff base; points that fail are unrecoverable at freeze instead of surfacing at run time. This removed 40 further points from the 143 versus 183 recoverable.

bridge.note: The calibration labels (260) and its INCONCLUSIVE report were drawn and scored on the earlier dataset. They are evidence only under amendment 2 (nothing is tuned on them), so the new partition's reshuffle of sessions does not invalidate them; the novelty step accepts the report for the new dataset only through this record.

unchanged: amendment 2 and every number in it (both-judges-same, 80 audited stratified by arm, upper bound 0.15)
the Pilot 1 decision rule and its thresholds (plan section 2.3)
the $125 total and $100 pilot hard caps, metered per call
reportingRequirement: The pilot's report states in its first lines that it measures the T1 decision only and that T2 is excluded, with the reason above.
